5:114.text: , said: "O Allâh, our Lord! Send us from the heaven a table spread
that there may be for us - for the first and the last of us - a festival and a sign from You; and provide us sustenance, for You are the Best of sustainers."

5:115.text: Allâh said: "I am going to send it down unto you, but if any of you after that disbelieves, then I will punish him with a torment such as I have not inflicted on anyone among

5:116.text: ! Did you say unto men: ‘Worship me and my mother as two gods besides Allâh?’ " He will say: "Glory be to You! It was not for me to say what I had no right
. Had I said such a thing, You would surely have known it. You know what is in my inner-self though I do not know what is in Yours; truly, You, only You, are the All-Knower of all that is hidden

5:117.text: "Never did I say to them aught except what You

did command me to say: ‘Worship Allâh, my Lord and your Lord.’ And I was a witness over them while I dwelt amongst them, but when You took me up, You were the Watcher over them; and You are a Witness to all things.
(This is a great admonition and warning to the Christians of the whole world)

5:118.text: "If You punish them, they are Your slaves, and if You forgive them, verily You, only You, are the All-Mighty, the All-Wise

5:119.text: Allâh will say: "This is a Day on which the truthful will profit from their truth: theirs are Gardens under which rivers flow
- they shall abide therein forever. Allâh is pleased with them and they with Him. That is the great success

5:120.text: To Allâh belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and all that is therein, and He is Able to do all things.
